title: The Rejection of the Master
english: The greatness of the one whom they denied is shown by the fact that he is the one who brought the people out of Egypt, intending salvation for them; but since some of them were turncoats and repetitive, still carrying the harm they had in Egypt, he destroyed those who were unfaithful in the wilderness, even though they had been saved from Egypt through faith. Therefore, let these not be the hypocrites of divine teaching who lead the Nicolaitan heresy, inciting no kind of immorality.

For it is shameful, and very shameful, to perform such things under the pretext of mystery, both those from Simon the Magician and those from Marcion, Valentinus, and the Sethians. And since they perform shameful things under the pretext of religion, he said the grace of the Lord was given to them to turn them toward debauchery, through which debauchery and its works they deny the only Master and Lord of us, Jesus Christ.

It has been said regarding him before this, that this only Master and Lord Jesus Christ is true God, the one who brought the people out of Egypt through Moses; it follows that there is no other god than Moses; for indeed there is no other besides the Trinity; whence Moses appears to be ministering to him according to: 'He wrote about me' (John 5:39) and: 'Whom Moses wrote, we have found, Jesus' (John 5:46). title: The Deception of False Teachers
english: By the cross of the Lord Jesus. He says that 'written beforehand' is used instead of 'foreknown' for this judgment. That is, foreknown, just as the things concerning Judas were also written beforehand.

Therefore, he called clouds, therefore, without water, because the one who draws water does not have the word of the Spirit with God-loving souls, which becomes to them a spring of water leaping into eternal life. He says this because the righteous again, while making themselves shady with olives and even with fruitful vines, went astray; so he says, as if some are unfruitful and autumnal, that is, both leaf-less and fruit-less.

Having killed the soul by dissolute life and impiety, and by wicked doctrines; or thus: because they died by impiety before faith, then having approached the gospel they lived, but again having surrendered themselves to impiety and pleasure, they have died; in this way he says they have died twice.

Even if imitating their leader Satan, who disguises himself as an angel of light, they themselves wish to be disguised as teachers of truth, concerning whom it was said: 'in whom you appear as lights in the world, possessing the word of life'; but rather they are deceiving, perverting the truth with dissoluteness and slanders, and later with error and gloom and darkness, which is the outer darkness, they shall be punished, which is prepared for Satan and his angels.
